decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 37.14 EUR. The case was opened within the time limit: TXN-008119 posted on 2026-08-07 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 84 days later, which is inside the 120-day limit (time-limits). The posted amount was 14326 cents (143.26 EUR). The authorisation AUTH-008307 was approved for 10612 cents (106.12 EUR) as a contactless payment. The merchant's receipt DOC-000072 shows a total of 106.12 EUR. The posting is higher than both the receipt and the authorised amount, so the 3714-cent difference was charged without agreement (amount-above-receipt). The credit covers only that difference, not the whole transaction. It matches the amount the cardholder claims and is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated provisional credit (provisional-credit).
